tagline: The eternal city — Ganga Aarti at dawn is transformative.
notes: Best visited Oct–Mar. Book a sunrise boat ride in advance.

tagline: Ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire set against a lunar boulder landscape.
notes: Rent a bicycle to explore the vast site. Stay on Hampi island for sunset views.

tagline: High-altitude desert passes, turquoise lakes, and Buddhist monasteries.
notes: Acclimatise for 2 days in Leh before heading to higher altitudes. Permits required for some areas.

tagline: Slow-boat through palm-fringed canals with legendary seafood.
notes: Overnight houseboat stays are the highlight. Book well in advance during peak season (Nov–Feb).
